skill.name: Spring Boot 3.0 Session Management Configuration Migration
skill.description: Migrate Spring Session configurations to Spring Boot 3.0 standards, including store type property updates and session configuration alignment with new conventions.
skill.skill_body:
Update Spring Session store type property and related configuration to match Spring Boot 3.0 conventions. Verify that the session store type is compatible with your deployment environment (Redis, database, etc.). Ensure session management functionality is preserved after migration.

## Objective

Migrate Spring Session configurations to Spring Boot 3.0 compatibility standards
## Applicable Signals

- Spring Session is configured for session management
- Target version is Spring Boot 3.0 or later
- Session store type property requires update

## Contraindications

- No Spring Session in use
- Target version is Spring Boot 2.7.x or earlier
- Spring Session is already Spring Boot 3.0 compliant

## Intervention Moves

- Migrate Spring Session store type property
- Update session configuration to match Spring Boot 3.0 conventions

## Workflow Steps

- {'step': 1, 'title': 'Update Session Configuration', 'action': 'Migrate Spring Session store type property; update session configuration to match Spring Boot 3.0 conventions'}
- {'step': 2, 'title': 'Validate Session Configuration', 'action': 'Verify session store type property is correctly configured; check for deprecated properties or annotations; validate configuration compatibility'}
- {'step': 3, 'title': 'Test Session Management', 'action': 'Start application and verify Spring Session store connectivity and session management function correctly'}

## Constraints

- Session store type must be compatible with the deployment environment
- Session configuration must follow Spring Boot 3.0 property naming conventions
- Session store connectivity must be validated after migration

## Cautions

- Validate session store connectivity (Redis, database, etc.) after migration
- Test session persistence and retrieval thoroughly
- Ensure session store credentials and connection settings are correctly configured

## Output Contract

- Updated Spring Session configurations compatible with Spring Boot 3.0; application starts successfully and session management functions correctly
